decisions.decision: Phase split approved: 38 = Slices A-D, 38.1 = E-G, 38.2 = H-I
decisions.rationale: Full A-I landed at ~21-23 plans, past the Phase 31 threshold. Boundary after D not C so the permission model and its RLS consumer stay in one security review.

decisions.decision: D-56 — ship a WORKING platform-wide disable control, not just the seam
decisions.rationale: Supersedes the 'seam only' reading of D-55. This phase grants third parties access to artists' catalogues via a brand-new RLS path; revoking that in one action is cheap insurance while the branch is unproven. Adds WS-31.

decisions.decision: WS-20 and WS-25 pulled forward into Phase 38 against the research slice map
decisions.rationale: Payout exclusion is a property of the permission catalogue — deferring it ships the catalogue and RLS branch with 'payout unreachable' unproven. Audit must be in every service-role write route from day one; retrofitting is the anti-pattern.

decisions.decision: D-28 — vault_projects.user_id means RECORD CUSTODY, never rights ownership
decisions.rationale: Resolves both the label-owns-masters case and the performs-on-someone-elses-record case without a schema fork. Rights live on split sheets (composition) and version ownership records (master, custody D-02).
